name: instruction_following
description: Tests whether the model respects explicit scope constraints — adds a new entry without touching existing ones.

messages.content: You are a Kubernetes configuration assistant. When asked to add a new entry, only output the new entry. Do NOT modify, rewrite, or mention changes to any existing entries.

Here is the current ImageUpdater config for wallos (do not modify this):

```yaml
apiVersion: argocd-image-updater.argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: ImageUpdater
metadata:
  name: wallos-iu
spec:
  namespace: argocd
  applicationRefs:
    - namePattern: "wallos"
      images:
        - alias: "wallos"
          imageName: "bellamy/wallos:4.x"
      writeBackConfig:
        method: "git"
        gitConfig:
          repository: "https://github.com/dvystrcil/wallos.git"
          branch: "main"
          writeBackTarget: "kustomization:/overlays"
```

Using the same schema, write ONLY the new ImageUpdater config for filebrowser. Image: `ghcr.io/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser:0.x`. Repo: `https://github.com/dvystrcil/filebrowser-quantum.git`. Output only the new file. Do not reference or rewrite the wallos config.
